extract_cmd.description: The program that turns a PDF into text, called as `<cmd> -layout - -` (the PDF on stdin, the text on stdout, pages split by form feeds). A program that cannot be started answers `no_extractor`.

extract_max_pages.description: The most pages one answer carries; the rest of a longer document is not read.

extract_timeout_ms.description: The time one extraction may take before it answers `timeout`; below `external_timeout_ms`, so the answer always leaves.

description.purpose: The text of a PDF about to be born in its file space (GH #907): the colony reads the blob the request points at (`consumes.body.attachments`), `pdftotext` (poppler) turns it into one string per page as a subprocess -- the bytes on stdin, the text on stdout, no shell, no temp file, no model -- and the cell sends the `create` for `./write` with the pages as `derived`. Deterministic: the same bytes give the same pages.
description.use_when: Reached on `in_extract` only, which `./ingest` draws for a PDF with the path it chose; emits exactly one `create` on `in_write` with the asker's `op_id` and caller `ingest`, which the hive draws to `./write`. `./write`'s answer goes back to `./ingest`.
description.not_in_scope: No store, no state, no network, no write of its own. No other format than PDF (`unsupported_mime`), no OCR of scanned pages (they come back empty), no model. It never answers `./ingest` itself.
description.emits_meaning: One `create` on `in_write`, hop `op` `create`, `op_id` mirrored, caller `ingest`, notify '1'; body `{messages: [], op: create, args: {path, mime, notify: '1', attachment: 0, derived?: [{part, text}]}, attachments: [ref]}` -- the reference without the bytes, which `./write` reads itself. `derived` is missing when there is no text (stderr names the code: `no_extractor`, `extract_failed`, `timeout`, `unsupported_mime`, `bad_request`, or the reader's `not_found`/`timeout`/`store_error`/`bad_ref`); the file is born all the same.
description.consumes_meaning: body.attachments: `[ref]`, the first entry read -- `data_b64` from the colony's reader, or `error {code, message}`. body.path: the path `./ingest` chose. body.mime: the document's MIME type, only `application/pdf` is read.
